description: LGL-BW Amtliche Strassenkarte 1:200 000 Farbkombination is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by owsproxy.lgl-bw.de. The service visualizes the official road map Baden-Württemberg 1:200 000 (ASK200). In it, selected contents of the DLM250, the DLM50 and technical data of the road construction administration Baden-Württemberg are presented. The thematic focus is on the representation of road transport (classified road network). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS LGL-BW Official road map 1:200 000 colour combination" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include view, opendata, StandardExtern, infoMapAccessService, AdVMIS, WMS_LGL-BW_ASK_200_K_V03. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-10-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.lgl-bw.de/agb/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
